other_conditions: The girl child's birth must be duly registered.
Only two girl children per family are eligible for the scheme.
The benefit applies only to girls born on or after the date of notification.
Parents/guardians must fulfill all prescribed conditions to receive the payment.
Applications must be submitted at the designated Anganwadi centers with the required documents.
benefits_summary: Cash transfer of Rs 2,000 for each girl aged 0‑1 year and Rs 1,000 after the child turns 1 year, payable to parents/guardians of up to two eligible girls per family.
